mapper.select: SELECT distinct mapped_variant_id, gene, variant, ori_variant, mutFreq,exon,codon FROM this_genetic_marker_vw where report_id = #{report_id} order by gene
select distinct gene_symbol,gene_variant from nkb_variant_treatment_annotation where gene_variant_id = #{gene_variant_id}
SELECT distinct description_chinese FROM nkb.onco_gene_variant_desc_vw where gene_variant_id = #{gene_variant_id} and checking_status='Approved'

SELECT distinct a.drug_id, a.drug_name_chinese, a.disease_name_chinese, a.relationship_category_chinese, a.annotation_chinese, a.evidence_phase_id, a.evidence_phase_chinese FROM nkb_variant_treatment_annotation a where a.relationship_category = 'Sensitive' and a.evidence_phase_id is not null and a.gene_variant_id = #{gene_variant_id} and a.approved_disease_id is not null and a.approved_disease_id not in (select evidence_cancer_id from panel_display where primary_cancer_id = #{primary_cancer_id} and is_primary='Y') order by a.evidence_phase_id desc;

SELECT distinct a.drug_id, a.drug_name_chinese, a.disease_name_chinese, a.relationship_category_chinese, a.annotation_chinese, a.evidence_phase_id, a.evidence_phase_chinese FROM nkb_variant_treatment_annotation a where a.relationship_category = 'Sensitive' and a.evidence_phase_id is not null and a.evidence_phase_id != 12 and a.gene_variant_id = #{gene_variant_id} and a.approved_disease_id is not null and a.approved_disease_id not in (select evidence_cancer_id from panel_display where primary_cancer_id = #{primary_cancer_id} and is_primary='Y') order by a.evidence_phase_id desc;

SELECT distinct a.drug_id, a.drug_name_chinese, a.disease_name_chinese, a.relationship_category_chinese, a.annotation_chinese, a.evidence_phase_id, a.evidence_phase_chinese FROM nkb_variant_treatment_annotation a where a.relationship_category = 'Sensitive' and a.evidence_phase_id is not null and a.evidence_phase_id != 12 and a.approved_disease_id is not null and a.gene_variant_id = #{gene_variant_id} and a.approved_disease_id is not null and a.approved_disease_id not in (select evidence_cancer_id from panel_display where primary_cancer_id = #{primary_cancer_id} and is_primary='Y') order by a.evidence_phase_id desc;

SELECT distinct a.drug_id, a.drug_name_chinese,d.disease_name_chinese as evidence_disease_name_chinese,a.clinical_trial_id, c.official_title_chinese, a.disease_name_chinese,c.phase,c.location_chinese FROM omics.nkb_variant_treatment_annotation a join nkb.clinical_trial c on a.clinical_trial_id = c.clinical_trial_id left outer join nkb.disease d on a.trial_disease_id = d.do_id where a.gene_variant_id = #{gene_variant_id} and a.relationship_category = 'Sensitive' and a.trial_indication = 'all' order by c.phase desc
